NK HAŠK 1903 Zagreb is a Croatian football club from Zagreb that currently competes in the Third Football League – Center. The club plays its home matches at the Donje Svetice ground in the Peščenica district of Zagreb. It was founded on November 23, 1990, as a continuation of the football section of the former HAŠK, which was abolished by decree of the communist authorities on June 4, 1945.
